Thanks for wanting to help. This repository only presents Delta MCP and has no code, and pull requests are limited to collaborators: the README files are built from the website's texts, so a sentence is changed at its source.

Please tell us instead:
- **a sentence that reads wrong in your language:** [General](https://github.com/mcpdelta/mcpdelta/discussions/new?category=general)
- **an idea:** [Ideas](https://github.com/mcpdelta/mcpdelta/discussions/new?category=ideas)
- **a question:** [Q&A](https://github.com/mcpdelta/mcpdelta/discussions/new?category=q-a)
